bass.tags: Cinematic ambient piano solo. A single acoustic grand piano plays a minimalist, repetitive motif in the key of C minor at 72 BPM. The performance features a high degree of sustain pedal usage, creating overlapping harmonic resonances. The left hand plays steady, low-register whole notes while the right hand executes a descending three-note melodic pattern. The recording captures mechanical noise from the piano hammers and dampers. A long-tail hall reverb is applied to the entire signal, softening the attack of the notes.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[soft acoustic piano enters, heavy sustain pedal]

[Main Theme]
[repetitive descending minor melody, low-register bass notes]
[mechanical hammer noise audible]

[Outro]
[final chord rings out with long reverb tail]
[silence]

drums.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A Rhodes piano plays a repetitive four-chord progression with a slight tremolo effect and high-frequency roll-off. The drum kit features a muffled, low-pass filtered kick drum and a crisp snare with a short decay. A sub-bass synth follows the root notes of the piano chords. A vinyl crackle texture persists throughout the track. The tempo is 85 BPM in the key of C major. The arrangement is minimalist with subtle variations in the piano velocity.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle, Rhodes piano chords with tremolo]

[Main Loop]
[muffled kick drum enters, crisp snare on beats 2 and 4]
[sub-bass synth follows piano root notes]

[Outro]
[drums and bass drop out]
[Rhodes piano fades out with vinyl crackle]

vocals.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A Rhodes electric piano plays a repetitive four-chord progression with a soft tremolo effect and high-frequency roll-off. A sampled acoustic drum kit features a dry, thumping kick drum and a crisp snare with a slight swing. A deep, sub-heavy synth bass follows the root notes of the piano chords. A subtle vinyl crackle layer persists throughout the track. A muted trumpet with heavy reverb plays short, melodic fragments in the upper register. 85 BPM. C Minor. 4/4 time.
vocals.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle begins]
[Rhodes electric piano plays four-chord progression]

[Main Section]
[sampled acoustic drums enter with swung eighth notes]
[sub-bass enters]
[muted trumpet with reverb plays melodic fragments]

[Outro]
[drums and bass drop out]
[Rhodes piano fades out]
[vinyl crackle fades to silence]
